newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Lace ask-only after new share cancellation.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Lace ask-only after new share cancellation.

text.p: Shares in Nippon Lace Co Ltd were ask-only on Monday morning after the company said on Friday it would cancel its plan for a third-party allocation of new shares, brokers said.
Shares of Nippon Lace, an embroidery lace manufacturer, stood ask-only at 224 yen at 0112 GMT, against Friday's close of 249 yen.
Last month, the firm had said it would go ahead with a previously cancelled plan for a third-party allocation of new shares to two investors in early April.
